method: Search Open Library by title and author, then retry title-only and translated-title searches.
Check title and normalized author identity on the work and associated edition records.
For translated titles indexed under a different work title, require a matching edition title.
Use the linked edition's publish_date, never the search index's first_publish_year, for Edition labels.
Add manually checked original years from author, publisher, cultural institution and library sources listed in original-years.json.
Retain existing dates and Goodreads links; these existing fields were not all independently reverified.
Mark unresolved dates explicitly and retain search links instead of inventing direct matches.
limits: Catalogue associations and publication dates are source-reported metadata and can contain errors.
This is a catalogue metadata audit, not independent inspection of every physical edition or every Goodreads destination.
The catalogue edition may use another language or printing than the displayed cover.
The remaining unresolved entries require further bibliographic research.
